_comment: The 14 recipes of the FROZEN skills/ copy in this repo (WI28, owner decision 2026-11-10); this file describes that copy and is not edited. scripts/sync-skills.sh no longer writes into skills/ and does not read this file by default: pass its own --recipes file naming only the recipes you publish.
